zh.title: Android 实时工作台与图像预览升级
items: Android 现在直接呈现 Codex 的真实流式回复，并用稳定消息身份合并增量与最终答案，不再使用模拟打字效果。
命令、文件、联网搜索和图像查看会按真实生命周期分组展示，活动状态、目标与命令摘要更清晰。
工具查看的本机图片通过端到端加密按需读取；会话先显示不超过 100KB 的缩略图，点按后才加载原图。
Markdown 引用改用适配深色界面的原生样式，长会话中的系统提醒和工具过程继续保持紧凑折叠。
新建会话、用户输入和最终回复的同步更可靠，并在 Web 与 Android 显示当前版本及最低兼容桌面版本。
邮箱验证邮件会跟随 Web 登录语言发送中文或英文内容。

en.title: Real-time Android workspace and image previews
items: Android now renders genuine Codex response deltas and merges them with the final answer through stable message identity, without simulated typing.
Commands, files, web searches, and image views are grouped by their real lifecycle with clearer status, subject, and command summaries.
Images viewed by tools are fetched on demand through end-to-end encryption; conversations show thumbnails capped at 100KB and load the original only when opened.
Markdown quotes now use a native dark-interface treatment while system reminders and tool activity remain compact in long conversations.
New sessions, user input, and final replies synchronize more reliably, and Web and Android now show the current version and minimum compatible desktop version.
Verification emails now follow the language selected on the Web sign-in screen.
